descriptions.zh:
- 您可通过此接口创建流程，也可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面手动创建流程。

- 在创建流程后，您可参考[流程编辑器组件说明](~~2836818~~)进行画布编排。
descriptions.en:
- This API operation creates a flow. You can also create a flow manually in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) interface.

- After you create a flow, you can orchestrate the canvas. For more information, see [Flow Editor components](~~2836818~~).
